groups.title: AC Repair

groups.intro: In the greater Houston area, a broken air conditioner during our 100°F-plus summers is more than uncomfortable. Our licensed technicians diagnose the problem for a $79 flat-rate service call and give you the price before any work begins. We fix every major residential brand.

services.title: Diagnostics and Flat-Rate Service Calls

services.title: No Cooling and Warm Air
services.text: A unit that will not turn on, keeps shutting off, blows warm air or makes a banging, squealing or clicking noise is traced to the part that caused it.

services.title: Refrigerant and Electrical Faults

services.title: Drainage and Condensate

services.title: Heat Pump Repair

about.title: Alvin's hometown HVAC company since 1986.
text: Since 1986, Mabry's Air Conditioning & Heating, Inc. has been providing honest, reliable HVAC services to homeowners across the greater Houston area. We started in Friendswood and expanded to our current office and shop on South Gordon Street in Alvin, building nearly four decades of trust in both communities and the surrounding cities.

For nearly four decades we have built our reputation on doing things the right way: honest assessments, quality workmanship, and fair, flat-rate pricing with no hidden charges. We do not believe in surprise fees or upselling services you do not need.

As a residential-only company, we focus exclusively on homes, not commercial buildings. That specialization means our technicians are experts in the systems that keep your family comfortable, and many of our customers are second and third generation.

faqs.q: What areas do you serve?
faqs.a: We serve Alvin, Friendswood, Pearland, Clear Lake, League City, Deer Park, Pasadena, Sienna, Angleton, Manvel, Rosharon, and the surrounding greater Houston area. Our office and shop is located at 2110 S Gordon St in Alvin (281-331-5248), and we have a dedicated service area covering Friendswood and the eastern territory (281-482-8400).

faqs.q: Are you licensed and insured?
faqs.a: Yes, we are a fully licensed Texas HVAC contractor (License TACLB12058E) and carry full insurance for your protection.

faqs.q: What does flat-rate pricing mean?
faqs.a: Flat-rate pricing means you get a clear, upfront price before any work begins: no surprise charges, no hourly rates that add up, and no hidden fees. The price we quote is the price you pay.

faqs.q: Do you offer emergency HVAC service?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer emergency service for urgent AC and heating repairs. Call our main line and we will do our best to help you as quickly as possible.

faqs.q: How long has Mabry's been in business?
faqs.a: Mabry's Air Conditioning & Heating has been family-owned and operated since 1986, nearly 40 years of serving the Alvin and greater Houston area.

faqs.q: Do you work on commercial properties?
faqs.a: No, we specialize exclusively in residential HVAC service. This focus allows our technicians to be true experts in home cooling and heating systems.

faqs.q: How often should I have my AC tuned up?
faqs.a: Once per year at minimum, ideally in spring before the Houston summer heat kicks in. If you have both a cooling and heating system, an annual AC tune-up in spring and a heating tune-up in fall is the ideal schedule.

faqs.q: Do you service older R-22 AC systems?
faqs.a: Yes. R-22 was phased out in 2020 and repairs on those systems can be costly, so we will tell you honestly when repair still makes sense and when replacement is the better value.

faqs.q: How much does AC repair cost in the Houston area?
faqs.a: AC repair costs vary depending on the issue and the parts required. Common repairs like capacitor replacement, refrigerant recharge or thermostat replacement typically range from $150 to $500. You know the exact flat-rate cost before any work begins, with no hidden charges.

faqs.q: Why is my AC blowing warm air?
faqs.a: Common causes are low refrigerant from a leak, a dirty air filter blocking airflow, frozen evaporator coils, a failed capacitor or a faulty compressor. In the Houston heat, low refrigerant and capacitor failures are especially common in summer.

faqs.q: How long does AC repair take?
faqs.a: Most AC repairs are completed in a single visit, typically one to three hours. We keep common parts stocked for Trane, Carrier, Lennox, Rheem, Goodman and other major brands, and we tell you upfront if a less common part has to be ordered.

faqs.q: Should I repair or replace my AC unit?
faqs.a: If your unit is 12 to 15 years or older and repairs are becoming frequent, replacement is often more cost-effective. We repair the vast majority of the units we are called out on and we never push an unnecessary replacement.

faqs.q: Why is my heater not producing heat?
faqs.a: Common causes are a tripped breaker, a thermostat problem, a dirty filter restricting airflow, a failed igniter or flame sensor on a gas furnace, or a stuck reversing valve on a heat pump. Houston heating systems sit unused for months, so components often fail the first time they are called on.

faqs.q: How long do furnaces typically last in Houston?
faqs.a: With proper annual maintenance, most gas furnaces last 18 to 25 years in Houston's climate, because they run fewer hours per year than in colder places. Heat pumps typically last 12 to 18 years.

faqs.q: What SEER rating should I get for a Houston home?
faqs.a: For the Houston area's nine-month cooling season we recommend a minimum of 16 SEER2. Higher-efficiency systems at 18 to 21-plus SEER2 offer substantial long-term savings, and we calculate the payback period so you can decide.

faqs.q: How long does AC installation take?
faqs.a: A standard residential AC installation typically takes one day. Projects that involve ductwork modifications may take longer, and we tell you upfront what to expect.

faqs.q: What size AC do I need for my home?
faqs.a: Proper sizing requires a Manual J load calculation based on square footage, ceiling height, insulation, windows and other factors. In the Houston area humidity is critical, because the system has to both cool and dehumidify. We never guess on sizing.

faqs.q: Will maintenance help lower my energy bills?
faqs.a: Yes. A dirty condenser coil, low refrigerant or impaired airflow can reduce efficiency by 10 to 25%, which shows up directly on your electric bill. In Houston, air conditioning can account for 50 to 60% of a summer electric bill.

faqs.q: Does annual maintenance keep my warranty valid?
faqs.a: Many manufacturers require documented annual maintenance to keep the warranty valid, and skipping it can void coverage on a later warranty repair. We can provide a written service record for your files.

faqs.q: Do you service heat pumps and all system types?
faqs.a: Yes. We perform maintenance on all residential system types including central air conditioning, heat pumps, gas furnaces, electric air handlers and mini-split systems, on all major brands.

faqs.q: Do you charge extra for evening or weekend service calls?
faqs.a: No. Flat-rate pricing applies to all calls at all times, with no extra charge for evenings or weekends, ever. The price you are quoted is the price you pay regardless of when we come out.

faqs.q: Are you a local company or a national chain?
faqs.a: We are your neighbors. Mabry's has been based at 2110 S Gordon St in Alvin since 1986, family-owned and operated, not a franchise or a national chain. When you call you talk to us, not a national call center.

faqs.q: What is your dedicated Friendswood phone number?
faqs.a: Our dedicated Friendswood service line is 281-482-8400. That line is specifically for Friendswood and the Bay Area, so you get faster routing and someone familiar with your area.
